newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-LEONARDO SAYS HE IS READY TO JOIN AC MILAN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LEONARDO SAYS HE IS READY TO JOIN AC MILAN.

text.p: Brazilian playmaker Leonardo has agreed to leave Paris St Germain to join AC Milan next season if the two clubs can come to an agreement.

"The two sides are negotiating and it's up to them to decide," the 27-year-old international said at Paris St Germain's training camp on Tuesday. "I have been approached by Milan but there's also a bid from Barcelona which is still valid," he added.
Leonardo denied press reports that he had already signed an agreement with Milan.
"I'd be happy to go to Milan but I feel very good in Paris too. I only want a decision to be made as quickly as possible," he said.

Paris St Germain were reported to have asked for a transfer fee of 80 million francs ($18 million) for Leonardo. His departure would leave the door open for compatriot Edmilson to join the Parisian side from Porto.
